en: Okay, got it. Actually, I was hoping to see that pitch again.
Why would you want to do that? Oh, whatever. Let's just get started.
Yeowch!
Hey, watch where you're⑬ Huh?
What the... It's gone! My phone!
Heheh. Gotcha again!
You! Gimme back my phone!
Yeah right! You really think I'm gonna just hand it over?
Lemme guess. You wanna challenge me again?
Yup! And this time, you'll need a miracle to hit it!
Why do you have to be such a rotten rascal? Can't you just ask me to bat against you?
Don't go talking down to me just 'cause you're a grown-up. If you can't hit my new pitch, I'm keeping this janky old phone.
What is your problem, kid? Don't think you can blackmail me into doing whatever you want.
Aww, you don't wanna bat? Okay. I'll just have to make a bunch of international calls on your phone, then. Where should I start first?
Wait, no, don't do that! Do you have any idea how expensive that gets!? Fine, I'll take you on! I'll even say please!
Good answer. Okay then, it'll be the same rules as last time. If you can get three hits out of ten pitches, you win.
All right. So, what's your miracle pitch this time? Another curveball? A slider?
Nope! Let's not spoil the fun. You ready to go?
No way. You even hit my Tomafork Mark 9!? Arrrrgh! This sucks!
Hey, kid. Kenta, right? Which little league do you play for?
Why, what's it to ya!?
I've never seen a kid throw a forkball with that kind of dip. You must have some crazy coach.
Take me to your coach right now. I need to chew this guy out, and fast.
Your coach is insane for letting a kid throw pitches like those. He's making you wreck your shoulder!
That's common knowledge for young players! What's your coach thinking? Take me to him right now.
Why are you so mad? It's none of your business anyway!
I'm concerned over your condition. I don't want you ending up out of the game for good.
...You mean you're worried about me?
Yeah. So tell me who your coach is. He needs a good, long lecture.
...I don't have one.
How is that possible?
Look, I'm not with any team! I don't play for anyone!
You sure about that?
Okay, I have to go now, bye!
Yo, awesome batter dude.
Well if it isn't Kotetsu the blogger. What's up?
Just ran into your nephew at the door. He said to give you this. It's a reward for hitting his miracle pitch, he said.
You got a <Color:8>Collateral Damage Belt<Color:Default>.
Oh, okay... Thanks.
Something happen? The kid was crying.
Let's just say he's going through something complicated.

What do you mean? He's your nephew, right? But, on second
thought, it's cool. I shouldn't be going around prying into
other people's business.
You got 800 experience points.
Too bad! Looks like my miracle pitch beat <Italic>you</Italic>! Again!
Okay, gotta go, buh-bye!
(Dangit! Beat by a kid again!)
I'm concerned about your condition. I don't want you ending up out of the game for good.
You mean... you're worried about me?
Just ran into your nephew at the door. He said to give you these.
Said it's your phone and a reward for hitting his miracle pitch.
Oh, okay. Thanks.
Too bad! Even a famous local batter can't get past my Tomafork Mark 9!
But you're not all that bad. Lemme practice on you again some other time, okay? Buh-bye now!
(How'd he make his pitches sink like that? That's one crazy kid...)
Yo, awesome batter dude. Your nephew gave me your phone. Said I should return it to you.
Uh, okay. Thanks.
(Where'd this kid learn to pitch? If he keeps throwing like that, he'll only end up injured later down the line...)
Hey! Been waiting for ya!
You again, miracle pitch kid? Hey, give me back that... uh... that coupon.
I know, I know. But if you want it back... Do I really need to explain?
Another miracle pitch duel? What was it? Panty Flash Mark 12?
Mm-hm! If you can get three hits out of ten pitches, you win. If you can't, I win.
Wait a minute. This must mean...
Heheh. Gotcha times three!
I knew it was you! All right, Kenta, what'd you swipe this time?

No... It couldn't be... It's gone! My massage parlor coupon!
Now how am I supposed to get my ham handled for half off!?
Huh. I don't know what that is, but it sounds important.
It's a ticket to the land of dreams for any man. But you're too young. Give it back!
If you want this back... Do you really need me to explain the rest?
No, I guess not. You want to challenge me with another of your miracle pitches, right?
You got it. Okay then, to the batting cage! You won't be hitting my miracle pitch today!
Wait a second. Are you still throwing those crazy breaking balls?
Didn't I tell you? A kid like you shouldn't be throwing those. Wait till you finish growing. You really could wreck yourself.
Yeah, yeah⑬fine! Besides, I said miracle pitch. I didn't say anything about a breaking ball.
Oh is that so?
Yup. Today I'll be throwing... a fastball. And since you're such a party pooper, I'll even throw it like a kid!
Can you <Italic>handle</Italic> that, mister? Sure ya can.
Okay, okay. But now we're talking about a little kid's fastball. Where's the miracle in that?
How about waiting until you see me throw? 'Cause this... is my trump card.
The rules are the same as before. If you can get three hits out of ten pitches, you win.
Nooo... Even my disappearing Panty Flash Mark 12 got whacked into oblivion!
(It's true. The ball did seem to flicker out of view. This kid's a freak!)
I can't do this! I can't think of any more miracle pitches that would get you.
Say, Kenta. You mentioned you weren't with a team. Why is that?
Because. Even if I join a team, there won't be anyone who can hit my stuff. It'll be boring.
You sure about that? I'll bet you actually wish you had other kids to play with. That's what made you cry before, right?
What am I s'posed to do? We keep moving around, and I'm always at some new school... I can never make any friends.
That's why it's easier to be by myself. Even if I join a team, it's not gonna work out. I know it.
I was that way too, you know. I didn't have many friends, either. It sure was scary joining a team for the first time.
Really? Even for a big guy like you?

Yeah. To be honest, I still had plenty of trouble after
joining the team, too. Getting along with people is always
gonna be tricky.
You get into any fights?
All the time. Had lots of bad experiences, too. But you know what? Chasing after a ball with all your teammates is more fun than you think.

You bet. That's the best part of baseball, that team aspect.
At least I think so.
Come on, try joining a team. All right?
But... Do you think I can really make it?
Sure you can. In a team, the people who put in an honest effort earn the greatest respect.
Besides, you throw some ridiculous pitches⑬and I mean that in a good way. Be confident! Okay?
...All right. Yeah. I'll do it!

But, remember, go easy on breaking balls. Those'll only
rip your joints straight outta their sockets!
Haha, I'll take your word for it. And... thanks. For everything. Here, you can have this.
Buh-bye!
See you! ...Uh, wait a second. Listen, where's that coupon you took?
Oh, that paper thingy? I think I lost it somewhere.
Aww, c'mon! That's no way to repay a favor. What'd you do with my dream ticket?
Woohoo! Looky what I got myself here! Didn't expect to find one of these babies at a batting center!
What? Hey! That's mine!
Half off! What a bargain! No time to waste! To the red lights of Kineicho I go!
Hey! Don't just leave me hanging!
My ticket... To the land where dreams come true...
I don't know what that was, but cheer up, big guy. When I become a pro, I'll get you those coupons by the stack! Just wait!
Heh. Okay, fair enough. That's something else to dream about.
Too bad! So much for beating my miracle pitch.
'Kay, that's all I needed. See ya again! Buh-bye!
(Gah! The brat still has my coupon!)
Too bad, so sad! That's my disappearing miracle pitch, Panty Flash Mark 12.
What a name...
Now, I can see you have potential, so I guess I could pitch against you again sometime. But for now, it's buh-bye!
Hey! My massage coupon! Come on, it's totally wasted in the hands of a kid...
Dammit all. I must win it back at all costs!
Oh, it's you. Are you still buffing your bat like a good little boy?
I'm feeling like another match. How about a home run derby?
I'll go into the cage for twenty pitches. You go in for the same count next. If you hit more homers, you win.
If we're tied, you win. Though I'm gonna crush you anyway. All right, let's do this!
Whew. Smacked seven again. How lucky of me.
Your turn. You need to bat at least seven out of twenty. That's home runs, if you get me. Think you got what it takes?
Oh, I know I do. It's showtime!

All right, I'm going up to bat first. I'll go for twenty
pitches, then you do the same. Whoever hits more home runs
wins the contest.
Got it. Oh, but what if we're tied?
Might as well just give you that win⑬I'm gonna crush you anyway. Let me show you how it's done.
Whew. Seven. Not bad.
Well, you do have decent form. That's why you're the Tokai Wonderkid, I guess.
Oh, I got it all right. It's showtime!
What the fuck!? This piece of shit's useless!
(What's this now?)
<Italic>Fuck!</Italic> <Italic>You</Italic>! Stupid fucking bat. Can't even hit a goddamn ball!
(Geez, taking it out on a bat? How dense can you get?)
Come on, fellas. Don't do that to the equipment. It's not the bat's fault⑬you probably just suck.
Huh? And who the fuck are you? You work here?
Nope, just a customer.
A customer? And you think you can lecture us? Step the fuck outside, big man.
*knock* *knock* *knock*
Hello? Is anyone home? I thought I'd just come by to greet my new neighbor.
(Did someone move in next door?)
(Just have to stay quiet...)
...Nobody home, huh? Oh well.
(That's all it takes? I should pretend I'm not home more often.)
Oh, hello there. I'm with the Nagasu Times, and I'd like to offer you a great deal on a newspaper subscription!
What? I thought you were here because you moved in.
No, you just moved in, right? So I came to welcome you into the neighborhood!
I've been living here six months.
Oh, you have? Huh, I didn't know that. I thought you must be a new resident.
In any case, I'd be more than happy to get you signed up with our paper. How about I give you a free trial for the first month? Cancellation fees may still apply.
So you're actually selling newspapers? And you use that moving in line to get people to open the door?
Hey, don't make it sound like I'm a criminal. I did say hi, didn't I? Now, all I need is your signature, and you'll be waking up to that fresh newspaper smell in no time!
No way. Try that scheme on someone else.
Oh, but... It's not that easy, you know. What with the proliferation of the internet and all, nobody reads the paper anymore. The medium's in danger of dying, friend.
Our goal at the Nagasu Times is to support more local news, so it would really help your community if you decided to join the cause. Besides, all your neighbors said yes.
Don't be a sore thumb. Come on. Is there any way I could get you to reconsider?
Okay, you sold me. I'll sign up.
Oh, you will? That's great! Let's make it a six-month subscription, shall we?
What? I thought you said I could try it out free for a month.
Well, you might as well go with at least six months, paid. It'd save you the trouble of renewing. Plus you get a better deal that way.
Oh, how about I throw in some detergent as well? Would that sweeten the deal? Nothing like waking up to a pile of clean clothes and the morning paper, am I right!?
Get out of here. I won't say it again.
What's with the attitude, bro? Is that any way to talk to a guest?
Hmph. You worm your way into someone's home, and now you're talking manners?
You watch your mouth, asshole. I don't take any bullshit from guys like you! Apologize to me right now! Do it!
Must be tough, huh?
I'm glad you can see this from our point of view. So, shall we work out your subscription?
What? I didn't say I'd subscribe. I just said it must be tough on you.
Well, shit. You could have been a bit more clear about that. Are you trying to make a fool out of me?
No, I changed my mind.
Huh? You can't just change your mind like that! Aren't you a man of your word?
You're the one who said a month to begin with. How about you keep your word as well?
